name: Postproxy
description:
Postproxy connects Claude to all of your Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X, Pinterest, Google Business, LinkedIn, TikTok, Threads, BlueSky and Telegram through a single API, so you can go from idea to published post — and handle everything that happens after — in one conversation.

Publishing
- Publish to one profile or many at once, or save drafts and publish them later
- Schedule with queues: define weekly timeslots and drop posts into the next open slot
- Upload media, target specific placements, and update or delete posts already live on-platform

Engagement
- Read, reply to, hide, like, and delete comments on your published posts
- Full direct messaging: list chats, send and edit messages, add reactions, and send private replies to commenters
- Respond to Google Business reviews

Analytics
- Pull stats snapshots for individual posts and follower and engagement timeseries for each profile

Setup
- List your connected profiles and profile groups, check available placements, and generate a link to connect a new account

Ask Claude to write this week's posts and queue them, clear your comment backlog, or summarize how last month's content performed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Postproxy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Postproxy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.postproxy.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Postproxy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Postproxy lists 45 MCP tools, including auth_status, comments_create, comments_delete, comments_get, comments_hide, comments_like, comments_list, comments_unhide, comments_unlike, dm_chat_archive, dm_chat_create, and dm_chat_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Postproxy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Postproxy in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Postproxy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Postproxy is developed by Postproxy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
